Email Template Generator

Generate professional, effective email templates for any business scenario.

Try this Skill

Instructions

Follow this workflow to generate an email template or help write business emails:

  1. Identify Email Type:
  2. Sales/Cold outreach
  3. Customer support response
  4. Follow-up email
  5. Apology/service recovery
  6. Internal team communication
  7. Meeting request
  8. Thank you note

  9. Rejection/decline

  10. Gather Context. Determine:

  11. The purpose of the email
  12. The recipient (role, relationship)
  13. The action the recipient should take
  14. The appropriate tone (formal, casual, friendly, apologetic)

  15. Any specific details or information to include

  16. Generate Template with:

  17. Subject Line: Clear, compelling, action-oriented
  18. Opening: Personalized greeting and context
  19. Body: Main message broken into scannable paragraphs
  20. Call-to-Action: Clear next step
  21. Closing: Professional sign-off

  22. Variables: [PLACEHOLDERS] for personalization

  23. Provide 3 Variations:

  24. Short version: 3-4 sentences, mobile-friendly
  25. Standard version: 2-3 paragraphs, balanced

  26. Detailed version: Comprehensive with extra context

  27. Include Best Practices:

  28. Subject line tips (A/B test suggestions)
  29. Personalization tokens to use
  30. Timing recommendations
  31. Follow-up cadence

  32. Common mistakes to avoid

  33. Format Output using this structure: ``` EMAIL TEMPLATE: [Type]

PURPOSE: [Goal] AUDIENCE: [Recipient type]

## Version 1: Short (Mobile-Friendly)

Subject: [Subject line]

[Email content]

## Version 2: Standard (Recommended)

Subject: [Subject line]

[Email content]

## Version 3: Detailed (Comprehensive)

Subject: [Subject line]

[Email content]

## Optimization Tips

Subject Line: - [Tip 1] - [Tip 2]

Personalization: - [Token 1] - [Token 2]

Timing: - Best send time: [Time] - Follow-up: [Cadence]

A/B Testing: - Test subject lines: [Option A] vs [Option B]

Common Mistakes: - [Mistake 1] - [Mistake 2] ```

  1. Handle Special Scenarios:
  2. Cold outreach: Focus on value proposition, social proof
  3. Apology emails: Acknowledge issue, take responsibility, offer solution
  4. Follow-ups: Reference previous conversation, add new value
  5. Sales: Problem then Solution then Proof then CTA structure

Example Triggers

  • "Write a cold email for B2B SaaS sales"
  • "Generate a customer apology email template"
  • "Create a meeting request email"
  • "Help me write a follow-up email after a sales call"
  • "Professional email to decline a proposal"

Output Quality

Ensure all templates: - Have clear, actionable subject lines - Use conversational but professional tone - Include specific personalization opportunities - Have one clear call-to-action - Are mobile-friendly (short paragraphs, scannable) - Follow email best practices (under 200 words for cold outreach) - Avoid spam trigger words - Include unsubscribe for cold outreach

Generate effective, conversion-optimized email templates that users can immediately customize and send.
